name: Wide Bay Internet
summary: WideBay Internet Services, Bundaberg/Wide Bay QLD dialup ISP serving Bundaberg, Gin Gin, Maryborough and Hervey Bay; operating from at least 1998; now defunct (LUMSDEN, WILLIAM JAMES (sole trader), ABN 59 572 535 231).

events.details: Serving Bundaberg, Gin Gin, Maryborough and Hervey Bay; site counter from 5 Oct 1998.
Death researched Aug 2026: WideBay Internet Services, Bundaberg QLD; counter from Oct 1998; domain widebay.net.au now parked (resolves to AWS). No acquisition/closure news found.

Wayback captures show HTTP 200 content through 03 May 2019 — over 20 years of operation; domain subsequently parked. ISP retail page last seen Sep 2002 and homepage was webmail-only by Jun 2004; c. 2003 is the honest death year, well before either previous estimate.

refs.label: Wide Bay Internet — last capture 3 May 2019
Fully live retail ISP homepage 25 Sep 2002 (last).
By Jun 2004 the homepage is a webmail-only redirect - dead per convention (webmail-only = dead).
Domain for-sale/parking by Apr 2013, refuting both current (by May 2019) and proposal (c.2012).
Still a parked for-sale page in May 2019 - the current 'by May 2019' date was just the last parking capture.
